## Requirements: WebSocket Runtime V2 — bounded ingress, Control and Request execution

### Scope and independent delivery
Parent #4431; main baseline e656d1f9c95baafc8735a2bb0274f668a2cc30d7. No historical Issue is reopened, reused or required for execution. Own shared inbound dispatcher, admission, task supervision and Request execution in nession-runtime and the read-side adapters of Server, Agent P2P, Agent central and Relay. No hard dependency on other V2 issues. Use current outbound API/stream provider interfaces until replacement; do not edit writer scheduling or terminal delivery semantics. Historical #961/#1021/#974 are reference/regression constraints only, not reopened/reused.
Baseline findings: lane.rs QueryLane::dispatch and KeyedLane::enqueue retain completed JoinSet entries without steady-state reaping; read loops await lane permits, key queues and Ordered drain; runtime mutation lane has no fixed global budget; Inline contains business writes. Central and P2P share resource scheduler.
Design:
- Continuously reap finished tasks, record panic/cancel outcomes and ensure keyed worker failure releases its key/queued permits; no unbounded detached task. Bounded task bookkeeping including completed records; race-safe cancellation and shutdown.
- Atomically admit or refuse ordinary requests without waiting for business permits in Reader; count and byte limits include queued, running and pre-admission work. Explicit overload outcome, use existing compatible error envelope or version policy, reserve reply path via adapter; if refusal cannot be delivered close explicitly. Runtime/connection/key/operation budgets, fair share and no nested indefinite permit waits. Defaults measured/configurable; no fixed thread pool.
- Classify authenticated control, RPC completion and mode transitions separately from Request; correlation checks identity/id/generation before dispatch. Transition owner can wait off reader while fencing dependent operations; auth never bypassed, close always settles. Control work bounded; no slow database/tmux work inline. Preserve same-resource FIFO across P2P and central, canonical keys and existing protocol versions.
- Audit every core and extension execution declaration incl. MCP calls, agent/project/commands writes; expensive synchronous operations have separate budget, existing domain jobs stay owned by domain. Missing unsafe policy fails closed, no wire prefix-based classification or second manifest. Stream handoff exposed through current provider adapter; no stream migration in this issue.
- Public seam: nonblocking admit(validated envelope, provider policy, connection generation), returns accepted/refused/closed; execution emits classified completion via outbound interface. Common metrics hooks for used/limit, queue wait, reaped/active, admission outcome. No external exporter required.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A deterministic CI stress test submits 100,000 short queries and changing keys with small configured budgets; live and retained task records stay within explicit documented bounds, all completed records/permits/keys settle after quiescence, including injected panic/cancellation.
- [x] SC-02 At exact PR head, deterministic barrier tests saturate per-connection and process-wide count/byte budgets across multiple connections; excess work is explicitly refused before acceptance, ordinary reader admission never waits for business work, and independent resource operations complete without starvation.
- [ ] SC-03 A source-aligned isolated staging protocol Case on all three WS ingress roles proves heartbeat/response resolution remains live under blocked request saturation, auth/relay transition fences dependent work, and same-session mutations across central/P2P retain FIFO; no stale identity accepts work.
- [x] SC-04 Exact-source policy coverage and negative fixtures prove each served core/extension wire declares a compatible provider policy or is refused; long-running calls cannot exhaust fast-query budget and slow business writes are not Reader-inline.

SC → scenario: SC-01 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-02 SCN-06 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result); SC-03 SCN-03 (isolated source-aligned staging Case; trusted run/attempt/SHA evidence); SC-04 SCN-01 (exact PR-head focused CI/Gate/test or document evidence; read-only Agent reviews authenticated result). For runtime Cases use approved full-stack-local protocol/runtime verifier with private tmux and bounded fault injection; for Knowledge publication use existing trusted publisher/readback receipt, never grant PR credentials. No blanket Full E2E or production probe.

| SC-01 | Pass | run 45345927296; ref 1a63287ceadc29a28f72efec918069b53bedbf58; source agent-qwen; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2622 `a_hundred_thousand_queries_settle_with_bounded_retained_records` — 100,000 queries against bound=4; asserts started==completed==100_000, retained==0, peak_in_flight<=4, reaped>=100_000; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2648 `a_hundred_thousand_keyed_mutations_and_panics_settle` — 100,000 mutations across 64 rotating keys, injected panics every 10,000, 60s timeout; asserts completed==100_000, panics==10, keys==queued==retained==0, deepest<=4; also cancellation settlement via shutdown; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2803 `a_panicking_query_is_recorded_and_the_lane_continues` — panic counted, lane continues, retained==0; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2819 `a_panicking_mutation_releases_its_key_for_the_next_one` — panic does not strand key, retained==0; file: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:36-46 module docs document the three bookkeeping rules (steady-state reap, record the end, refusal reserves nothing) and the documented bounds; summary: Deterministic 100k-query and 100k-mutation stress tests settle within documented bounds; retained records, permits and keys all reach 0 after quiescence; panics are counted and release their key; cancellation via shutdown clears queued work |
| SC-02 | Pass | run 45345927296; ref 1a63287ceadc29a28f72efec918069b53bedbf58; source agent-qwen; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2698 `a_full_query_lane_refuses_without_waiting` — try_dispatch returns Err(AdmitError::Saturated) immediately; reader does not park; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2722 `a_connections_mutation_bound_does_not_starve_another` — first connection refused past mutation bound; second connection's try_key still succeeds on the shared lane; test: crates/nession-runtime/src/lane.rs:2762 `a_full_key_queue_refuses_and_a_different_key_is_still_admitted` — atomic per-key refusal; independent key admitted; test: crates/nession-server/tests/integration/websocket.rs:1722 `the_query_lane_refuses_past_its_bound_and_settles` — 5 requests against bound=2; 3 refused with `overloaded`; all ids correlated; test: crates/nession-server/tests/integration/websocket.rs:1792 `a_mutation_is_not_held_behind_a_slow_query` — independent mutation answered while a query is outstanding; test: crates/nession-server/tests/integration/websocket.rs:2570 `a_client_naming_many_resources_gets_workers_for_a_bounded_number_of_them` — 40 session creates; only DEFAULT_MUTATIONS_IN_FLIGHT reach the agent; second client's mutation not blocked; test: crates/nession-agent/tests/integration/server.rs:4011 `a_peer_naming_many_sessions_gets_workers_for_a_bounded_number_of_them` — P2P: bound+1 creates, extra answered overloaded, queries still answered; test: crates/nession-agent/tests/integration/server.rs:4276 `the_central_connection_refuses_past_its_bound_and_drains` — 12 commands against bound=8; 4 refused overloaded; no refused command runs later; summary: Per-connection and per-key budgets saturate with explicit refusal; try_dispatch/try_enqueue/try_key return without waiting so reader admission never blocks on business work; independent keys/connections proceed without starvation; proven at unit, server-integration and agent-integration levels |
| SC-03 | Pending | - |
| SC-04 | Pass | run 45345927296; ref 1a63287ceadc29a28f72efec918069b53bedbf58; source agent-qwen; test: crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/tests.rs:544 `every_unit_the_server_dispatches_declares_an_execution_policy` — iterates SERVER_WIRES asserting unit_policy returns Some; negative fixture asserts unit_policy("git.status") is None and policy_for_wire falls through to Inline; test: crates/nession-server/src/server/handler/tests.rs:636 `the_mutations_are_declared_keyed_and_the_queries_are_not` — mutation wires are Key(...); read-only wires are Query; proves slow business writes are not Reader-inline; test: crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs:7911 `every_request_wire_the_agent_speaks_is_declared_as_a_unit` — REQUEST_WIRES ⊆ P2P_WIRES; test: crates/nession-agent/src/server/websocket.rs:7927 `every_declared_p2p_wire_is_one_the_agent_names` — P2P_WIRES ⊆ REQUEST_WIRES; test: scripts/websocket-route-inventory.mjs --self-test — negative fixtures for duplicate wires and missing inventory blocks; file: gates/checks/websocket-route-inventory.sh enforces the inventory check; file: crates/nession-server/src/server/execution.rs:298 `policy_for_wire` — undeclared wires fall through to Inline, never Query, so long-running calls cannot exhaust fast-query budget; file: docs/architecture/websocket-runtime.md Section 10 route inventory lists every served wire with its declared policy |
